name: EXIF Digital Autopsy (Metadata Integrity)
description: The operating system polygraph. Authentic glass-and-silicon cameras inject a colossal amount of hardware telemetry straight into the binary blood of an image (EXIF, IPTC)—sensor IDs, aperture grids, flash syncs, and raw GPS codes. Cyber-fraudsters (Photoshop users) and Generative AI vats routinely strip, falsify, or completely lack this immutable skeletal encryption. If the hardware data is purged, fractured, or barren = Instant execution for forgery.
algorithm: Low-level Binary Header Decompilation & Logic Extraction
mechanism: Ignoring the subjective 'beauty' of the pixels completely, this protocol violently guts the deepest binary segments scanning for EXIF tags. Shutter speed reads 1/200s but the image is smeared with motion blur? Logic failure. A premium Lens ID but completely missing the native sRGB chromatic mapping tag? Logic failure. Or worst of all, the signature merely reads 'Adobe Photoshop', 'Stable Diffusion', or is utterly scrubbed raw? An immediate arrest warrant is issued.
parameters: Target Zones: EXIF/IPTC/XMP Binary Boxes, Analytics: Telemetry Cross-Verification Matrix
accuracy: Absolute (90-99% Conditional) - Shoot first, ask questions later against any image refusing to produce its hardware-level cryptographic passport.
source: ISO Standardized Camera Hardware Meta-Forensics Archives
useCase: Goes directly for the throat of the data wrapper. Deployed as the elite vanguard tool to instantly decapitate amateur fraudsters who foolishly forget to medically scrub the file's header before distribution.

references.title: Kee, E., et al. (2011). Digital image authentication from JPEG headers. IEEE TIFS.
JEITA CP-3451C — Exchangeable Image File Format (Exif) Version 2.32
Farid, H. (2019). Image Forensics. Annual Review of Vision Science.

strengths:
• Absolute iron-clad evidence in legal proceedings. Native AI-generated exports frequently ship with completely barren EXIF data, serving as an explicit, undeniable algorithmic confession.
• Blazing 0.001-second execution time regardless of whether the image is 1K or 8K, exclusively interrogating binary text headers.
limitations:
• The forensic ax shatters completely against elite Anti-Forensics syndicates. A single line of ExifTool code allows hackers to clone legitimate camera telemetry directly into a fake Deepfake, spoofing the radar seamlessly.
• Catastrophically disarmed against social media laundering. Facebook/WhatsApp intentionally nuke 100% of EXIF wrappers to compress bandwidth, triggering mass False Positives on authentically shared photos.
